request.prompt:
SCENE: Jaw Bank. The same hand and the same build as the reference image.

ONE single full-frame view. Not a grid, not panels, not insets. No text, no labels, no lettering anywhere, no interface.

NEAR VIEW. Sky: the WRONG PLACE — night, the sky a sick olive green, a close yellow fog that swallows everything past about thirty blocks, dull red clouds, the full moon a pale smear through the fog. No blue sky, no bright white moon.
A player stands on the mud bank under the creature's head: the head lies on the mud filling the frame, the jaw dropped in a long low gape with irregular pale post-like teeth, a dark throat beyond; the shut eye and the pale carved tablet in the forehead above; on each side of the mouth, well clear of the path between them, a long segmented tentacle of dark hide blocks rises from a pit; a few small salvage lamps on the mud.
THE CREATURE (draw it exactly so, the same creature in every view): a stranded deep-sea leviathan, a horror and not a cartoon, built of blocks, about 140 blocks long and 45 high, lying on its belly sunk into its own bank of black mud — never floating, never low in water. Its head lies on the mud at its north end with the jaw dropped open in a long low gape full of irregular pale post-like teeth (never a round ring of teeth), an eye socket on each side with the eye shut, and a tall pale carved stone tablet driven into the forehead above the eye. A short neck runs to the shoulder, the highest point of the back; a ridge of bony vertebral spines runs along the back; a round blowhole sits on the back behind the head; the torso narrows to the hips. Three torn wounds on its west flank with pale rib bands standing out of them; two flippers splayed flat on the mud; a long tail sweeping back from under the rump and ending in two flukes laid flat on the mud. Colours: dark leathery hide of black, dark grey and brown blocks with dull grey-teal patches; bone-white spines, ribs, skull, flippers and flukes; red-brown flesh in the wounds and the mouth. No bright colours, no turquoise, no fins on the back, no cartoon face.
request.style_note: The Stranding: every image in this series is one place drawn in the same hand — a Minecraft Java Edition build shown as a high-quality in-game screenshot with a soft night shader. Every surface is made of visible one-metre cubic blocks with vanilla Minecraft textures (cobblestone, stone bricks, spruce and dark oak planks and logs, deepslate, mud and packed mud, black and grey concrete, prismarine, lanterns, glass panes), crisp block edges, no smooth curves anywhere: round or organic forms are stepped block shapes. The place is a grey slate-roofed fishing town on cliff terraces above a bay, a plain of wet black mud risen from the bay, and a vast stranded sea creature built of dark blocks lying at the far edge of the mud. Night under a clear sky and a bright full moon: cold blue-silver moonlight on wet mud and slate roofs, deep blue-black shadows, small warm yellow pools of lantern light at doors and windows, sea water near-black with silver moon glints. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset, never a caption, no text, no labels, no border, no interface.
